items.title: Rectangular recurrence relations for off-shell Bethe vectors in odd orthogonal invariant models
items.author: Andrii Liashyk; Stanislav Pakuliak; Eric Ragoucy

items.difficulty_reason: The odd orthogonal recurrence has additional same-color two-element partitions, shifted spectral parameters and three index domains absent from the gl(n) recurrence. The author gives separate zero-mode seed recurrences and explicit symmetrized identities for the required induction paths in AppendixB. This substantive type-B structure is not an immediate specialization of the type-A theorem.

primary.label: Counted o(2n+1) rectangular recurrence theorem main-th

proof_spans.label: Complete author AppendixB, titled Sketch of the proof, including all three index domains and rational identities
